Fixture Ocean Robotics Lab

A competitive four-week summer internship building underwater robots alongside graduate researchers.

Eligibility

Open to current 11th and 12th grade students residing in San Diego County.

Program Dates

The 2027 cohort ran June 1 through June 26, 2027; applications for 2027 are now closed.

Stipend

Selected students receive a $1,000 stipend.

How to Apply

Applications for the 2027 cohort closed January 15, 2027. Check back next year for 2028 dates.
